name: past.dev
summary: past.dev is a hosted memory API for AI agents. Applications send timestamped text to an ingest endpoint and query a recall endpoint, which returns ranked evidence with dated sources, tracks how facts change over time, and filters results by what the requesting identity is allowed to see.
facts: REST ingest and recall, plus a remote MCP server
Pay as you go from $45; Flex $99/mo; Enterprise custom
Hermes Agent plugin maintained by past.dev
goodFor: Multi-user or team memory with access control
Facts that change over time and need sources
Agents that need memory over MCP
watchOut: New product (launched Sept-Oct 2026); no named customers published
Benchmark comparisons use each vendor's own runs, not one harness
